I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

That comes from Dana's message in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, saying Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again during the morning shift. Thea was also the customer contact on the #inc-qfl-sev1 incident, where trailers were duplicating. Marcus is a member of both channels.

A contact name counts as operational information, not a finance figure, so it can be shared with the North team.
